release.title: Version 1.3.0
release.subtitle: Feed, search & discovery experience
new_features: Added a full Discovery page with trending content and a smooth feed/discover navigation flow
Added a complete Search experience for tracks, profiles, and playlists with tabs, suggestions, and recent searches
Added genre and vibe browsing pages so users can explore music by category
Added a new real Home page with top playlists, trending tracks, genre chips, notification shortcuts, messages shortcut, upload shortcut, and profile access
Added richer deep-link support for tracks, playlists, profiles, search links, and resolved shared resources
Added playback support from Home, Feed, Search, and Discovery contexts
improvements: Reworked the Feed page with improved loading, empty, error, refresh, and pagination states
Improved feed cards with better track actions, optimistic like/repost behavior, and playback handling
Updated app routing to support /discover, /search, /search/active, and /genre routes
Updated dependency injection registrations for the new feed, search, discovery, home, playback, and profile flows
Improved profile loading with aggregate profile data, playlists, and liked playlists support
Improved premium-aware UI surfaces on Home and Feed
Improved playback queue/context handling across the new music discovery surfaces
Updated Android, release workflow, CI workflow, and API constants to support the new feature set
bug_fixes: Fixed router tests and navigation expectations after replacing mock pages with real Home and Search pages
Fixed SearchCubit tests to match the current SearchUseCase signature and SharedPreferences recents loading behavior
Fixed outdated feed test setup that referenced removed FeedState.initial() and FeedCubit.load() APIs
Fixed direct imports of part files by importing SearchCubit instead of search_state.dart
Fixed update-dialog launch behavior to avoid false-negative URL launch checks on some Android environments
Fixed several model, DTO, and state compatibility issues introduced by the new feed/search/discovery payloads
